newsitem.title: USA: Excel Industries completes brake unit sale.
newsitem.headline: Excel Industries completes brake unit sale.

text.p: Excel Industries Inc said Wednesday it completed the previously announced sale of its automotive parking brake business to Dura Automotive Systems Inc for cash. The price was not disclosed.
Excel said it acquired the product line when it purchased Anderson Industries in April 1996. It contributed about $12 million of sales to Excel last year, less than two percent of total sales.
Excel makes window, door and seating systems, recreational vehicle appliances, and complex injection-molded parts.
